name: Jev for computer use
tagline: Drives a visible Chrome window through web tasks, with screenshots as the fallback
description: Runs browser work in a Chrome window you can watch, clicking through pages with typed actions rather than guessing from pixels. When a page offers nothing usable to click, it steps down to screenshot-based control to finish the job. It slots in beside the other Jev templates as the one that operates a browser.
author: aris_grivas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
